name: Westfield MainPlace
description: Westfield MainPlace is a premier enclosed regional shopping destination in Santa Ana, California, featuring over 140 specialty stores and department store anchors. The center offers a comprehensive shopping experience with a diverse mix of fashion, dining, and entertainment options, complemented by modern amenities including Smart Parking and click-and-collect services.
demographics: Orange County shoppers, families, young professionals, diverse community including Hispanic and Asian demographics
summary: A leading regional mall in Orange County offering 140+ stores with upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment in an enclosed climate-controlled environment.
